runs.summary: Retry failed calls to the payment provider with exponential backoff and jitter, capped at five attempts; the HTTP client wraps every request and gives up on 4xx responses.
Evitar procesar dos veces el mismo webhook del proveedor: se guarda la clave de idempotencia de cada evento y los reenvíos se descartan antes de cobrar.
Fetch daily currency exchange rates from the central bank and cache them for invoice conversion.
Generate invoice PDFs with the company logo and the tax breakdown per line.
Rename the amount column without downtime: add the new column, write to both, backfill, switch reads, then drop the old column in a later release.
Write an append-only audit log of every change to a customer's billing plan.
Token bucket rate limiter keyed by API key, stored in Redis, returning 429 with a Retry-After header when a client exceeds its quota.
On SIGTERM stop accepting new connections, let in-flight requests finish with a 30 second deadline, then close the listener and the database pool.
Add a request ID to every incoming request and propagate it to upstream services and logs.
Reload TLS certificates from disk when they change, without restarting the process.
Configure CORS allowed origins per route from the gateway config file.
Send an email alert to the on-call engineer when a node shuts down unexpectedly.
Infinite scroll on the orders page using cursor-based pagination: the API returns an opaque next cursor instead of page numbers, so new rows never shift the results.
Activar funciones nuevas solo para un porcentaje de los usuarios, con el porcentaje en la configuración remota y el mismo usuario siempre en el mismo grupo.
Keep users signed in: short-lived access tokens, refresh tokens rotated on every use, and reuse of an old refresh token revokes the whole session.
Show a retry button on the checkout page when the network request fails, and a spinner while it reloads.
Add a dark mode toggle that follows the operating system preference by default.
Validate the signup form on blur and show the error under each field.
Import multi-gigabyte CSV files row by row with a streaming reader and batched inserts, so memory stays flat regardless of file size.
Scheduled jobs ran an hour late after the daylight saving change because the cron times were stored in local time; store them in UTC with the user's time zone and convert at trigger time.
Replace the whitespace tokenizer of the search index with one that splits on punctuation and lowercases tokens.
Export the daily aggregates to Parquet files partitioned by date.
Merge duplicate customer records that share an email address, keeping the most recent name.
A backfill job that recomputes metrics for a date range in parallel chunks.
Pre-commit hook that scans the staged diff for API keys, private keys and tokens and blocks the commit when it finds one.
Post the terraform plan as a comment on the pull request.
Alertas cuando el disco de un servidor supera el 85 por ciento de uso.
Rotate nightly database backups, keeping seven daily, four weekly and twelve monthly copies.
Rotate the deploy SSH keys every ninety days and remove the old keys from all hosts.
Ship application logs to the central log store with a sidecar.
Detect files changed by a shell command: snapshot the hashes of the files git sees as changed before the command and compare them after it, then report the ones a rule forbids.
Check for a new release once a day, cache the answer, and tell the user how to update.
Install the plugin with one curl command that verifies the checksum of the download.
Run mutation testing on the changed Go packages and report the surviving mutants.
Fail CI when the changelog lists the same entry twice within a release.
Refuse a push or a commit straight to the protected branches from the agent.

procesar archivos enormes sin cargarlos enteros en memoria
gradually enable a new feature for a share of the users
evitar que se suban claves o contraseñas al repositorio
saber qué archivos modificó un script después de ejecutarlo

change a database column in production without taking the service down
